findings.title: Runner GitHub reads fail items on transient errors (DESIGN §20 retries and rate-limit delay missing)
findings.detail: runner/github_read.py GitHubRead._get makes one attempt: any httpx error or status >= 400 raises GitHubReadError (its 'transient' property is unused). discover catches it per target, but vet._facts and scout's issue_text/_prs/not_relevant do not, so Scheduler.run_one's catch-all sets FAILED internal:githubreaderror (terminal for VETTING/SCOUTING). DESIGN §20 requires 3 retries at 2/8/30 s for timeout/5xx with error_class github_unavailable, and a delayed stage (sleep until reset, at most 1 h) on a 403 rate limit. Confirmed live: c_D1A3KD4FNB (comet-ml/opik) and c_D1A3KCMPGG (openlit/openlit) are FAILED internal:githubreaderror at 2026-10-18T22:04:02Z after proxy 3140 refused the connection (runner journal, vet._facts). Autonomous items return only after the 7-day cooldown, and a /v1/work item must be sent again. Fix: retries in _get, Deferred/delay for 403 x-ratelimit-remaining 0 or 429, StageFailed('github_unavailable') after the retries; fake-transport tests (connect refused, 502 then 200, rate limit, final class).

findings.title: Re-scout backoff (held) blocks the owner's next decision in any later state
findings.detail: Scheduler.held[cid] = (count, next_try) is set when a stage fails in a NO_FAIL state and is cleared only after a successful stage for that cid. _dispatch skips the cid while it is held, before stage_for, without comparing states. After a failed re-scout from RESCOPE_REQUIRED, the owner's Continue (ProposalService.continue_rescope, RESCOPE_REQUIRED -> PACKAGING) is not dispatched until the hold ends: 10 min after the first failure, up to 6 h after repeated ones, with no further message. NO_FAIL also covers AWAITING_APPROVAL..SUBMIT_FAILED, where the 'revising the proposal failed' text would be wrong. test_rescope_dispatch.py does not cover a state change during the backoff. Fix: store the state with the hold, skip only while the state is unchanged, drop the entry otherwise; test failed rescope re-scout -> continue_rescope -> package dispatched on the next tick.

findings.title: TRACEABILITY: rows only FEAT-006 can close left missing, DES-V-8 closed with its FEAT-007 half open
findings.detail: DES-FR-21, CR4-2d and CHAT-32 (phase FEAT-005 + FEAT-006; both parts recorded as done; FEAT-005 is closed) are still 'missing'. DES-FR-10, DES-FR-21, CR4-2d and CHAT-32 carry the generic 'runner/{scheduler,pipeline,errors,stages/*}.py ... (914d20a, fcefda3, a51fa5f, 2457 hermetic passed)' string instead of their evidence (test_size_report/scoring; size report vs estimate; review.enforce_tests + prompts/{coder,reviewer}.md; .kiro/agents + prompts). DES-V-8 (phase FEAT-006 + FEAT-007, ACP half for FEAT-007) is 'done', so the FEAT-007 matrix check will not list it. Fix: close the three rows with real evidence, set DES-V-8 to missing with 'FEAT-006 part done' like DES-V-9, recount Totals.

findings.title: Stray tool text in the ADR-0006 round-2 addendum
findings.detail: Item 17 (read-only part) ends with 'Content was rephrased for compliance with licensing restrictions.', which is not part of the record. Remove the sentence.

findings.title: An interrupted ossctl discover request is dropped silently
findings.detail: Scheduler.tick consumes the request with gk.claim_discover(); if a stop, kill, pause or drain ends that targeted cycle, Scheduler.discover catches Interrupted and returns [] without re-queueing the request or telling the owner (only a full cycle resets last_discovery). Re-queue the request or note that it was dropped.
